New Human School · The East

Heisig’s meaning-bearing pieces

Ordered components, ordinary character primitives, and traditional radical families. English memory labels stay separate from character meanings. Open a card for the source and any documented smaller parts.

This catalogue is a broad teaching inventory, not a claim that every card is an irreducible atom. Approximate RTK anchors combine edition crosswalks and documented shape use. Exact source references are retained in the JSON. Special shapes use embedded SVGs; everything here works offline.

I Ching

Drawing; no single Unicode character asserted

component or variant not classified as atomic

Meaning, components & sources

Four strokes in two separated pairs; no exact contiguous Unicode character asserted. Four short strokes arranged as two separated pairs, with other content inserted between; not the kanji 髙 produced by broken PDF text encoding. Modern 脊268 already uses shape. No Unicode equivalence assigned.
